sonnet.problem: The setup says 'flocks need water' just before the question about Abraham's complaint. That points straight to the well and makes the wrong answers (stolen sheep, a burned field) obviously wrong, so the baker doesn't have to reason it out.
sonnet.rule: A setup line can't rule out the wrong answers either.

sonnet.problem: Cards 3 and 7 already tell the baker that Abraham is asked to 'swear an oath' and answers 'I swear it.' That gives away that the name Beersheba comes from the two men swearing an oath, and the wrong answers (flocks grazing, army camping) are ruled out by the earlier cards.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.

sonnet.problem: 'Meanwhile' makes Abraham's tree planting happen at the same time as something else. The text says only that he planted the tree after the covenant and after Abimelech and Phicol left (21:32-33), so this adds a timing the text doesn't give.
sonnet.rule: Times stay true. No time in the text means none added.
